rows.title: Start from idle loads the first part
rows.expected: run = true; first serial loaded within 5 sim-s; IN RUNNING
rows.actual: run = True; SYR-B07-000001 loaded after 0.2 sim-s; IN RUNNING

rows.title: Stop freezes production and keeps progress
rows.expected: All stations STOPPED; pallets, buffers, transfers and counts unchanged for 30 sim-s
rows.actual: all STOPPED = True; state unchanged over 30 sim-s = True

rows.title: Restart after Stop resumes from the same point
rows.expected: Production continues; no part lost or duplicated

rows.title: E-stop stops every station and latches F001
rows.expected: run = false; F001 active; all stations STOPPED

rows.title: Reset and Start are refused while E-stop is engaged
rows.expected: Reset leaves F001 latched; Start rejected
rows.actual: latched after Reset = True; Start → "Release E-stop and reset its latch before Start."

rows.title: Recovery order: release → Reset → Start
rows.expected: Start refused before Reset; running after Reset + Start
rows.actual: Start before Reset refused = True; after Reset + Start run = True

rows.title: Natural overload from tool wear
rows.expected: F201 when a press force exceeds 160 N (demo profile)
rows.actual: F201 at 869.2 sim-s; force 161.9 N on SYR-B07-000086; wear 0.86

rows.title: Injected overload is traceable as injected
rows.expected: F201 latched; part event tagged injected = true
rows.actual: S2 fault F201; SYR-B07-000014 injected tag = True

rows.title: F201 is local: the line keeps running
rows.expected: run = true after F201; S2 FAULT; tower light RED
rows.actual: run = True; S2 FAULT; lamp RED

rows.title: Upstream blocks and downstream starves
rows.expected: S1 BLOCKED within 30 sim-s; S3 STARVED within 25 sim-s; IN BLOCKED
rows.actual: after the trip: S1 BLOCKED at 4.1 sim-s, S3 STARVED at 5.0 sim-s, IN BLOCKED at 0.0 sim-s

rows.title: Throughput drops while S2 is down
rows.expected: No good exit once the line has drained; downtime accumulates
rows.actual: good units 54 → 54 over 180 sim-s; S2 unplanned downtime 300 s

rows.title: Reset before repair is refused
rows.expected: F201 stays latched
rows.actual: S2 fault after Reset = F201; "F201 remains latched: repair must finish before reset."

rows.title: Repair (90 sim-s) then Reset resumes S2 at RETRACT
rows.expected: tool_ok after 90 s, wear = 0; S2 resumes at RETRACT; line produces again
rows.actual: repair took 90.0 sim-s, wear after repair 0.000; resumed at RETRACT; good 54 → 71 in 200 sim-s

rows.title: Affected part is rejected R2 and keeps its trace
rows.expected: Part exits as FAIL with R2; overload event in its history
rows.actual: SYR-B07-000086: FAIL ['R2', 'R3']; overload event in trace = True; 42 events

rows.title: Every decision matches its measurements
rows.expected: R1–R5 assigned exactly when a limit is violated; PASS parts are inside every limit
rows.actual: 141 inspection decisions checked against raw measurements; 0 mismatches

rows.title: Force out of window raises leak failures
rows.expected: Mean leak rate of out-of-window parts > 5 Pa/s; in-window ≈ 2 Pa/s
rows.actual: out-of-window mean leak 8.09 Pa/s (n = 85); in-window 2.01 Pa/s (n = 56)

rows.title: Rejected parts are diverted at S4, never packed
rows.expected: Every FAIL part leaves at S4 (diverted); every PASS part is unloaded at OUT

rows.title: Part conservation on every tick
rows.expected: in = good + reject + WIP on each of 36 000 ticks (1 sim-hour)
rows.actual: max imbalance 0 required, measured 0; final in 148 = 56 + 85 + 7

rows.title: Ten unique pallets are always accounted for
rows.expected: Pallet check true on every tick; WIP ≤ 10

rows.title: Boxes of ten
rows.expected: boxes = good // 10 throughout the run

rows.title: FIFO: parts finish in the order they were loaded
rows.expected: Completion order equals serial order

rows.title: Empty hopper starves IN; refill arrives after 30 sim-s
rows.expected: No load while empty; IN STARVED (material empty); production resumes after refill
rows.actual: loads while empty: 0; production resumed 30.2 sim-s after emptying

rows.title: Low stock raises a warning and an automatic refill
rows.expected: W001 below 30 barrels; hopper back to 300 after 30 sim-s
rows.actual: W001 after 3.4 sim-s; hopper refilled to 300 after 30.0 sim-s

rows.title: Planned tool change waits for the cycle boundary
rows.expected: 20 sim-s planned downtime; no unplanned downtime; wear reset
rows.actual: planned 20.0 s; unplanned 0.0 s; wear after 0.008

rows.title: Design rate with wear and noise off
rows.expected: 360 good units/h ± 5 % after a 300 sim-s warm-up

rows.title: Little's Law on the same window
rows.expected: |WIP − λ·W| / WIP < 10 %

rows.title: Determinism: same seed, same result
rows.expected: Identical counts and last force after 1000 sim-s
rows.actual: run A {'in': 105, 'good': 56, 'reject': 40}; run B {'in': 105, 'good': 56, 'reject': 40}; identical = True

rows.title: The live twin is never modified
rows.expected: Live state identical before and after a what-if run

rows.title: "Keep running" forecasts the live line
rows.expected: Forecast next-F201 time equals the live outcome (± 1 tick)

rows.title: Maintenance decision
rows.expected: Condition-based changes recommended; fewer F201 and rejects in 5/5 seeds
rows.actual: good/h: keep 217, change now 234, condition-based 337; F201 2.0 → 0.0; wins 5/5

rows.title: Speeding up a non-bottleneck gives nothing
rows.expected: S1 cure 3 → 2 s: < 2 % change; keep current recommended

rows.title: Speeding up the bottleneck moves it
rows.expected: S2 insert 3 → 0.5 s: > 10 % gain; design bottleneck moves S2 → S1
rows.actual: good 336 → 429 (+27.7%); design capacity 360 → 450/h, bottleneck S2 → S1

rows.title: Start/Stop through the PLC run permissive
rows.expected: Twin runs only while M_SYS_RUN = 1
rows.actual: before Start run = False; after Start True; after Stop stopped = True

rows.title: PLC detects the overload and gates recovery
rows.expected: F201 coil on force > 160 N; Reset refused until repair; resume after Reset
rows.actual: F201 at force 161.1 N; held after early Reset = True; cleared after repair + Reset = True

rows.title: Lost PLC link stops the line safely
rows.expected: F002 within ~1 s; line stopped; Reset needed after the link returns
rows.actual: stopped with F002 = True; Start refused before Reset = True; running after Reset + Start = True

rows.title: PLC counters agree with the twin
rows.expected: C_IN, C_GOOD, C_REJECT match twin counts over 600 sim-s
